material_read: Matte white ceramic, resembling technical porcelain.
fix_direction: Introduce sparse, fine hairline cracking to meet the specified pass target.
Subtly enhance the ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture to be more discernible without compromising the smooth, matte finish.
summary: The material successfully achieves a clean, matte, and engineered white ceramic appearance, avoiding common fail drifts like plastic or plaster. However, it fails to incorporate the required sparse fine hairline cracking and lacks a clearly discernible ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture, preventing a full pass.
